title.ar: اللوغاريتمات والدوال الأسية والتحويل للخط المستقيم

topics: Solving a^x = b and natural logs (ln)
Linear law: y = ab^x to Y = mX + c
Power law: y = Ax^n to ln y = ln A + n ln x

body.en: Comprehensive mastery of exponential modeling, logarithmic properties, change of base, and the essential Cambridge experimental skill of transforming non-linear data into straight lines.

1. Exponential Relationship \( y = ab^x \):
Take natural logs of both sides: \( \ln y = \ln(a \cdot b^x) = \ln a + x \ln b \).
In \( Y = mX + c \) form: \( Y = \ln y \), \( X = x \), gradient \( m = \ln b \implies b = e^m \), and intercept \( c = \ln a \implies a = e^c \).

2. Power Relationship \( y = Ax^n \):
\( \ln y = \ln A + n \ln x \).
Here: \( Y = \ln y \), \( X = \ln x \), gradient \( m = n \), and intercept \( c = \ln A \implies A = e^c \).

label.en: Worked Example 3.A — Linear Law Model Fitting

body.en:
Variables \( x \) and \( y \) are related by \( y = ab^x \). A plot of \( \ln y \) against \( x \) produces a straight line passing through \( (2, 3.4) \) and \( (6, 5.8) \). Find the values of \( a \) and \( b \) to 3 significant figures.

Solution:
Gradient \( m = \frac{5.8 - 3.4}{6 - 2} = \frac{2.4}{4} = 0.6 \).
Since \( m = \ln b \implies \ln b = 0.6 \implies b = e^{0.6} \approx 1.82 \).
Equation of line: \( Y - 3.4 = 0.6(X - 2) \implies Y = 0.6X + 2.2 \).
The vertical intercept is \( c = 2.2 \).
Since \( c = \ln a \implies a = e^{2.2} \approx 9.03 \).
Answer: \( a \approx 9.03, \, b \approx 1.82 \).
